Context: app/Services/HumanResources/LeaveApprovalService.php already has context(), approvals($model) (returns whereNull('leave_status_id') rows of the passed approval model), and gridData(Collection $approvals, string $type) with per-type grid builders (hodGridData/supervisorGridData/dirGridData/hrGridData) that compute every per-row display variable (each grid row is a get_defined_vars() array keyed by approval id, including $leav, $staff or $staff1, $backup, $bappb, $suppb, $hoddb, $dirrb, $u, $stadept, $ul, $ls is NOT in rows). ($row['ul'] == $ctx['us']) : true); can = visible && ($row['backup']->count() ? !is_null($row['backup']->first()->leave_status_id) : true). hod: visible = $ctx['me5'] || (($ctx['deptid'] == 28 || $ctx['deptid'] == 21) && (in_array($row['stadept'], [2,3,4,8,18,19,20,25,32,27,30,21,28]) || $row['staff']->div_id == 4)) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 6 && in_array($row['stadept'], [6,7,3])) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 23 && in_array($row['stadept'], [23,17,11,16])) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 1 && $row['stadept'] == 1) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 5 && $row['stadept'] == 5) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 12 && $row['stadept'] == 12) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 14 && $row['stadept'] == 14) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 15 && $row['stadept'] == 15) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 22 && $row['stadept'] == 22) || ($ctx['deptid'] == 24 && $row['stadept'] == 24); can = visible && $row['bappb']. dir: can = $row['backup']->count() ? !is_null($row['backup']->first()->leave_status_id) : true. hr: can = $row['bappb'] && $row['suppb'] && $row['hoddb'] && $row['dirrb']. '', 3, ' >').'', 'leave_type_code'=>$row['leavtype']?->leave_type_code ?? '', 'reason'=>''.Str::limit($row['leav']->reason ?? '', 7, ' >').'', 'date_applied'=>Carbon::parse($a->created_at)->format('j M Y'), 'dts'=>$row['dts'], 'dte'=>$row['dte'], 'dper'=>$row['dper'], 'bapp'=>$row['bapp'], 'supp'=>$row['supp'] ?? '', 'hodd'=>$row['hodd'] ?? '', 'dirr'=>$row['dirr'] ?? '', 'approve'=>$can ? '' : '', 'modal_html'=>$modalHtml]; return $rows. Then edit app/Http/Controllers/API/AjaxSupportController.php (read-only API controller - add imports for the four approval models and LeaveApprovalService at the top) and add a public method `public function leaveApprovalTable(Request $request, string $type): JsonResponse` that returns response()->json(['data' => (new LeaveApprovalService())->tableData($type)]). Then edit routes/api.php inside the existing `Route::middleware(['auth:sanctum', 'auth'])->group(...)` + `Route::controller(AjaxSupportController::class)->group(...)` block add: `Route::get('/leaveapproval/{type}', 'leaveApprovalTable')->name('api.leaveapproval.table');`. Verify: php -l on the service and controller; `php artisan tinker --execute="echo json_encode(['count'=>count((new App\Services\HumanResources\LeaveApprovalService())->tableData('supervisor'))]);"` must print a JSON with count >= 0 without throwing; `php artisan route:list --path=leaveapproval` must show the new route with GET and auth middleware. Report the method outputs and route:list line. Do not modify the existing PATCH endpoints in app/Http/Controllers/API/ModelAjaxCRUDController.php (they already exist and stay untouched).

tasks.title: Rewrite the four leave-approval index blades + their four JS modules to API-driven DataTables (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Context: the read API endpoint `GET api/leaveapproval/{type}` (route name api.leaveapproval.table, type in supervisor|hod|dir|hr) returns `{data: [...]}` where each row has keys DT_RowClass, leave_no_link, username, name, leave_type_code, reason, date_applied, dts, dte, dper, bapp, supp, hodd, dirr (empty strings when not applicable), approve (HTML button, empty when the user cannot approve), modal_html (the full approval modal HTML, empty when not approvable). The PATCH endpoints already exist: leavestatus.supervisorstatus / leavestatus.hodstatus / leavestatus.dirstatus / leavestatus.hrstatus (they accept id, leave_status_id, verify_code, remarks and return JSON {status,message}). REWRITE these four files (edit in place, keep them slim): resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/leave/{supervisor,hod,dir,hr}leaveapproval/index.blade.php. Each becomes: @extends('layouts.app'), @section('content') with `<div class="page-... container row align-items-start justify-content-center">`, @include('humanresources.hrdept.navhr'), a role gate: supervisor blade `@if($s1)`, hod blade `@if($h1)`, dir blade `@if($d1)`, hr blade `@if($r1)` (these come from $service->context() passed by the controller - controllers stay as they are except they must still pass context(); the current controllers pass 'approvals' and 'grid' too - it is fine to leave those lines but the blades will no longer use them; do NOT edit the controllers). Inside the gate: `<h4>` heading (Supervisor Approval / Head Of Department Approval / Director Approval / Human Resource Approval) and `<table class="table table-hover table-sm" id="leaveapproval-{type}" style="font-size:12px">` with a <thead> matching the legacy columns: supervisor/hod/dir: Leave ID | ID | Name | Leave | Reason | Date Applied | Date/Time Leave (From,To colspan) | Period | Backup Status | Approval; hr: the same plus Supervisor Status | HOD Status | Director Status before Approval. Empty <tbody>. Then @section('js') defining the window.data bridge exactly like the salescustomer index does (inline, no _js partial): `window.data = { route: { patch: '{{ route('leavestatus.supervisorstatus') }}' }, url: { table: '{{ route('api.leaveapproval.table', 'supervisor') }}' }, type: 'supervisor', old: {}, errors: @json($errors->toArray()) };` with the per-type route name and type slug. THEN rewrite the four JS modules (edit in place): resources/js/modules/leaveapprovalsupervisor/index.js, leaveapprovalhod/index.js, leaveapprovaldir/index.js, leaveapprovalhr/index.js. Each starts with `const { route, url, old, errors } = window.data;` and: (1) builds the DataTable: `var table = $('#leaveapproval-' + window.data.type).DataTable({ ...config.datatable, processing: true, serverSide: false, ajax: { url: url.table, dataSrc: 'data' }, columns: [ {data:'leave_no_link'},{data:'username'},{data:'name'},{data:'leave_type_code'},{data:'reason'},{data:'date_applied'},{data:'dts'},{data:'dte'},{data:'dper'},{data:'bapp'}, (hr only: {data:'supp'},{data:'hodd'},{data:'dirr'}), {data:'approve', orderable:false} ], columnDefs: [ { type: 'date', targets: [5,6,7] } ], order: [[6, 'desc']], paging: false, rowCallback: function(row, data){ if (data.DT_RowClass) $(row).addClass(data.DT_RowClass); }, initComplete: function(){ $('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip({ ...config.tooltip }); } });` (2) approve-button click handler (delegated on document): when a `.approve-btn` is clicked, take the button's data-id, find the row data via the table (`table.row($(this).closest('tr')).data()`), append `data.modal_html` to `$('body')`, then `new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById(window.data.type + 'approval' + id)).show()`; when the modal's `hidden.bs.modal` fires, remove the appended element. (3) form submit handler (delegated on document, same as the current leaveapprovalhod/index.js pattern but reading inputs from the modal): `$(document).on('submit', '.form', async function (e) { e.preventDefault(); let form = $(this); let ids = form.data('id'); try { const response = await $.ajax({ url: route.patch, type: 'PATCH', data: { id: ids, leave_status_id: form.find('input[name="leave_status_id"]:checked').val(), verify_code: form.find('input[name="verify_code"]').val(), remarks: form.find('textarea[name="remarks"]').val() }, dataType: 'json' }); $('#' + window.data.type + 'approval' + ids).modal('hide'); swal.fire('Success!', response.message, 'success'); table.ajax.reload(); } catch (err) { let res = err.responseJSON ?? { message: 'Unknown error' }; swal.fire('Error!', res.message, 'error'); } });`. IMPORTANT: the modal form must carry `data-id="{{ $approval_id }}"` on the <form> tag inside the partial (add it to the partial created in task 1 if missing) so `form.data('id')` works. Do NOT change anything in app/Http/Controllers or app/Services. Verify: `php -l` is N/A for blades; run `npx mix` (must compile - this confirms the four JS modules are picked up), `php artisan view:cache` must not throw (blade syntax check), and `php artisan route:list --path=leaveapproval` must show the four page routes (leaveapprovalsupervisor/leaveapprovalhod/leaveapprovaldirector/leaveapprovalhr) plus api/leaveapproval/{type}. Report the mix result and the route:list lines.

dependsOn: Rewrite the four leave-approval index blades + their four JS modules to API-driven DataTables (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Context: the read API endpoint `GET api/leaveapproval/{type}` (route name api.leaveapproval.table, type in supervisor|hod|dir|hr) returns `{data: [...]}` where each row has keys DT_RowClass, leave_no_link, username, name, leave_type_code, reason, date_applied, dts, dte, dper, bapp, supp, hodd, dirr (empty strings when not applicable), approve (HTML button, empty when the user cannot approve), modal_html (the full approval modal HTML, empty when not approvable). The PATCH endpoints already exist: leavestatus.supervisorstatus / leavestatus.hodstatus / leavestatus.dirstatus / leavestatus.hrstatus (they accept id, leave_status_id, verify_code, remarks and return JSON {status,message}). REWRITE these four files (edit in place, keep them slim): resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/leave/{supervisor,hod,dir,hr}leaveapproval/index.blade.php. Each becomes: @extends('layouts.app'), @section('content') with `<div class="page-... container row align-items-start justify-content-center">`, @include('humanresources.hrdept.navhr'), a role gate: supervisor blade `@if($s1)`, hod blade `@if($h1)`, dir blade `@if($d1)`, hr blade `@if($r1)` (these come from $service->context() passed by the controller - controllers stay as they are except they must still pass context(); the current controllers pass 'approvals' and 'grid' too - it is fine to leave those lines but the blades will no longer use them; do NOT edit the controllers). Inside the gate: `<h4>` heading (Supervisor Approval / Head Of Department Approval / Director Approval / Human Resource Approval) and `<table class="table table-hover table-sm" id="leaveapproval-{type}" style="font-size:12px">` with a <thead> matching the legacy columns: supervisor/hod/dir: Leave ID | ID | Name | Leave | Reason | Date Applied | Date/Time Leave (From,To colspan) | Period | Backup Status | Approval; hr: the same plus Supervisor Status | HOD Status | Director Status before Approval. Empty <tbody>. Then @section('js') defining the window.data bridge exactly like the salescustomer index does (inline, no _js partial): `window.data = { route: { patch: '{{ route('leavestatus.supervisorstatus') }}' }, url: { table: '{{ route('api.leaveapproval.table', 'supervisor') }}' }, type: 'supervisor', old: {}, errors: @json($errors->toArray()) };` with the per-type route name and type slug. THEN rewrite the four JS modules (edit in place): resources/js/modules/leaveapprovalsupervisor/index.js, leaveapprovalhod/index.js, leaveapprovaldir/index.js, leaveapprovalhr/index.js. Each starts with `const { route, url, old, errors } = window.data;` and: (1) builds the DataTable: `var table = $('#leaveapproval-' + window.data.type).DataTable({ ...config.datatable, processing: true, serverSide: false, ajax: { url: url.table, dataSrc: 'data' }, columns: [ {data:'leave_no_link'},{data:'username'},{data:'name'},{data:'leave_type_code'},{data:'reason'},{data:'date_applied'},{data:'dts'},{data:'dte'},{data:'dper'},{data:'bapp'}, (hr only: {data:'supp'},{data:'hodd'},{data:'dirr'}), {data:'approve', orderable:false} ], columnDefs: [ { type: 'date', targets: [5,6,7] } ], order: [[6, 'desc']], paging: false, rowCallback: function(row, data){ if (data.DT_RowClass) $(row).addClass(data.DT_RowClass); }, initComplete: function(){ $('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip({ ...config.tooltip }); } });` (2) approve-button click handler (delegated on document): when a `.approve-btn` is clicked, take the button's data-id, find the row data via the table (`table.row($(this).closest('tr')).data()`), append `data.modal_html` to `$('body')`, then `new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById(window.data.type + 'approval' + id)).show()`; when the modal's `hidden.bs.modal` fires, remove the appended element. (3) form submit handler (delegated on document, same as the current leaveapprovalhod/index.js pattern but reading inputs from the modal): `$(document).on('submit', '.form', async function (e) { e.preventDefault(); let form = $(this); let ids = form.data('id'); try { const response = await $.ajax({ url: route.patch, type: 'PATCH', data: { id: ids, leave_status_id: form.find('input[name="leave_status_id"]:checked').val(), verify_code: form.find('input[name="verify_code"]').val(), remarks: form.find('textarea[name="remarks"]').val() }, dataType: 'json' }); $('#' + window.data.type + 'approval' + ids).modal('hide'); swal.fire('Success!', response.message, 'success'); table.ajax.reload(); } catch (err) { let res = err.responseJSON ?? { message: 'Unknown error' }; swal.fire('Error!', res.message, 'error'); } });`. IMPORTANT: the modal form must carry `data-id="{{ $approval_id }}"` on the <form> tag inside the partial (add it to the partial created in task 1 if missing) so `form.data('id')` works. Do NOT change anything in app/Http/Controllers or app/Services. Verify: `php -l` is N/A for blades; run `npx mix` (must compile - this confirms the four JS modules are picked up), `php artisan view:cache` must not throw (blade syntax check), and `php artisan route:list --path=leaveapproval` must show the four page routes (leaveapprovalsupervisor/leaveapprovalhod/leaveapprovaldirector/leaveapprovalhr) plus api/leaveapproval/{type}. Report the mix result and the route:list lines.

tasks.title: Document the leave-approval API + DataTable transformation (this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Create the changelog file docs/changelog/2026-08-17-leave-approval-api-datatable.md (create the docs/changelog directory if missing) describing: the four legacy blades (supervisor/hod/dir/hr leave approval index) were transformed from server-rendered tables with per-row embedded modals (~300-2300 lines each) into slim DataTable shells fed by a new read API endpoint `GET api/leaveapproval/{type}` (AjaxSupportController@leaveApprovalTable, auth middleware); all business logic remains in App\Services\HumanResources\LeaveApprovalService (context(), approvals(), gridData(), new tableData() + canApprove()); the per-row approval modal is now a single shared partial resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/leave/_approval_modal.blade.php rendered server-side per row; the four JS modules (resources/js/modules/leaveapproval*/index.js) now load the table via DataTables ajax, open the modal from row data and submit approvals to the existing PATCH endpoints (leavestatus.supervisorstatus/hodstatus/dirstatus/hrstatus in ModelAjaxCRUDController, unchanged); row visibility and can-approve rules ported verbatim from the legacy blade conditionals (HOD viewer-dept decision tree, supervisor branch match, backup-approved gating, HR four-status gating). Note verification results (php artisan test, npx mix, route:list) with the actual numbers from the tester's report. Do not invent details. Report the exact file created and a one-line summary.
